title: [Claude] Track and minimise local patches to vendored code (stb_ds seed fix)
body:
## Problem
PR #81 fixed the stb_ds hash seed race (#78) by editing `vendor/stb_ds.h` (removing the per-table LCG advance of the global seed). Máté approved it but does not want vendored code modified: patched vendor files drift from upstream and make updates risky. `vendor/jimp.h` is already locally patched (ADR 0003), so there are now two.

## Proposal
1. Record every local vendor patch in one place (e.g. `vendor/PATCHES.md` with the upstream version, the diff summary and the reason) so an upgrade can replay them. Add the two existing ones.
2. For stb_ds specifically, check whether the fix can live in `src/` instead: e.g. a build-time define upstream already supports, or creating all hash maps on one thread before the JS thread starts. If neither works, propose the change upstream to nothings/stb and keep the local patch marked `VitaDeck:` as it is now.

Posted by Claude Code [claude-fable-5-1]
